correctness.instructions: Are any of the 8 pinned commits, trees, license/NOTICE blob SHAs, candidate paths, dependency inventories, include/exclude manifests, performance caps, or strongest-implementation claims factually wrong against the observed donor state at verification time?

evidence.instructions: Are the 9 conformance tests sufficient for immutable pins, lock-manifest-fixture consistency, founder authorization scope, rights quarantine, audit-only state with no runtime import, and no paid AI/GPU/cloud dependency?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterministic pin, mutable ref, future verification date, unresolved VERIFY_AT_IMPORT, missing imported_paths invariant, or unrepeatable ls-remote plus API verification?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond source-only audit: runtime donor code, reimplementation, migration, UI, provider activation, billing, or unrelated refactors?

security.instructions: Does the audit leak secrets, grant asset/model/service/trademark rights, admit quarantined media bytes, introduce paid egress, weaken actor-scoped reads, or misrepresent Fair Source versus open-source grants?
